newsitem.title: UK: Energy Group up as Goldman Sachs upgrades.
newsitem.headline: Energy Group up as Goldman Sachs upgrades.

text.p: Shares in The Energy Group Plc climbed on Wednesday after Goldman Sachs added the stock to its recommended list, dealers said.
Energy Group, which was demerged from Hanson last month, was previously rated "market outperformer" by Goldman Sachs, market sources said.
The shares were up 17p at 488-1/2 by 0948 GMT.
Dealers said Energy Group shares were also benefiting from buying by bargain-hunters after the stock's recent slide.
It has dropped from a high of 575p in late February to a low of 463 on March 21.
